r2_blockers.title: CI format gate fails on the reviewed head: application_integration_test.gleam unformatted
r2_blockers.evidence: The `let assert Ok(entry) =` bind is joined onto one line in server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam (~line 342). Verified directly with the exact CI gate commands at sha 645ae7f: `gleam format --check .` exits 0 in shared/, client/, and server/. CI run 31246154865 on this head: 'test / Format, Lint, Unit Test & Build' SUCCESS. The r2→r3 delta for this file is exactly the 3-line format join.

r2_warnings_notes.title: Client reducer ApiReturnedStatusUpdate 'viewed' arm has no client-unit test
r2_warnings_notes.evidence: api_returned_status_update_maps_viewed_test (client/test/client_test.gleam:654-681) seeds a Shortlisted detail, dispatches client.update(m, msg.ApiReturnedStatusUpdate(Ok("viewed"))), and asserts d.application.status == application.Viewed with a `_ -> should.fail()` guard. The reducer's silent `_ -> app.status` fallback (client/src/client.gleam:3132) means removing the `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` arm flips the assertion to Shortlisted == Viewed and fails. CI unit job SUCCESS on this head confirms it compiles and passes.
